title: Al‑Nejashi Mosque: A Testament to Ethiopia's Early Islamic Heritage
excerpt: Visit one of the oldest mosques in Africa, where companions of the Prophet Muhammad found refuge in the 7th century.
content:
Only 30 km from Adigrat lies Al‑Nejashi, a mosque of immense historical and spiritual significance. In the 7th century, a group of early Muslims fled persecution in Mecca and were granted asylum by the Axumite king. They settled here, and the mosque built in their honor still stands today.

The site includes the mosque itself, a cemetery with tombstones bearing Kufic inscriptions, and a small museum. It is a place of pilgrimage for Ethiopian Muslims and a fascinating cultural stop for all visitors. The peaceful atmosphere and beautiful surroundings make it a worthwhile excursion.

Our concierge can arrange a half‑day trip with a knowledgeable guide who will share the rich history. Afterward, you can sample local refreshments in the nearby village.
author: Canaan Hotel Team
